profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer - TypeScript | Node | React | C# | SQL
profile.summary:
**Software Developer | Former Structural Engineer | Multi-Domain Innovator**  
I’m a software developer with a robust background as a structural engineer, blending technical expertise across industries to create impactful solutions. My journey spans software development, teaching, engineering analysis, & design. Along the way, I’ve contributed to full-stack applications for desktop, web, and mobile platforms, with a growing focus on distributed computing, microservices, and cloud technologies.  

### **Career Evolution & Expertise**  
Starting in architecture & structural engineering, I honed my skills in analysis, design, & combined visual & technical problem-solving, earning my BA. in Architecture & M.Eng. in Structural Engineering from UC Berkeley. My transition into software engineering allowed me to combine engineering rigor with coding creativity & visual design. Over 13+ years, I’ve worked on:  
- Building & testing cutting-edge structural analysis software, scaling efficiency by 500% using tools like C#, WPF, and VBA.  
- Developing intuitive applications that streamline workflows & enhance user experiences.  
- Implementing full-stack solutions in TypeScript, React, & Node.js, leveraging microservices & cloud infrastructure on AWS.  

### **Key Skills**  
- **Programming Languages:** TypeScript, C#, Python, HTML5/CSS3  
- **Frameworks & Tools:** React, Django, WPF, GraphQL  
- **Engineering Tools:** SAP2000, ETABS  
- **Cloud & DevOps:** AWS, Docker, GitLab CI/CD  

### **Achievements in Software Development**  
- Improved front-end accessibility & WCAG compliance at Pluralsight, enhancing user inclusivity.  
- Automated verification frameworks that expanded testing coverage by 400% at Computers & Structures, Inc.  

### **Teaching & Leadership**  
My passion for mentorship extends to teaching topics like structural design, statics, & outdoor skills such as mountaineering & skiing. These experiences reflect my ability to break down complex concepts and inspire confidence in others—a strength I aim to carry into roles like product owner or tech lead.  

### **What’s Next?**  
My ultimate goal is to grow into leadership roles at the intersection of engineering & software, focusing on distributed computing and cloud-based innovation. I’m currently enhancing my skill set with certifications in AWS/Docker and personal projects in React/WebGL/Node.  

Let’s connect if you’re passionate about solving tough challenges, driving innovation, or exploring opportunities in product development, cloud computing, and software leadership.

positions.title: Design Structural Engineer
positions.description:
Designing the structural system for and overseeing the construction of custom homes, duplexes, and apartments in the Denver metro area. Job duties included: 
- Streamlining and extending company calculation spreadsheets, including automation with VBA & reading original source papers for implementing new features, such as for yield line theory in designing basement walls by working out cases with multivariable calculus to generate closed-form solutions for commonly encountered cases.
- Producing structural plans and detail schematics with Revit and AutoCAD software. 
- Performing design & analysis calculations with RISA and Excel. 
- Conducting site inspections of construction projects: footings, walls, sheathing, and framing. 
- Participating in meetings with architects to facilitate the design/engineering of the structures.
positions.insights: Skills: Structural Engineering · AutoCAD · Revit · Software Development · VBA · Structural Analysis

positions.title: Project - Atelier Single Page App, Front End | React, Node, Express, WebPack, Babel
positions.description:
- Developed the ‘Product Details’ feature, including image navigation & shopping cart, using React for the UI & Express to interface with RESTful API endpoints for user navigation & purchases on a variety of devices.
- Created an interactive & scalable layout of thumbnail selector carousels & banner image using CSS3, HTML5 & made the banner zoomable & pannable using JQuery to allow users to seamlessly inspect & navigate between products & styles.
- Improved robustness & data gathering with error boundary & click tracker higher order components.
- Optimized loading, interactivity & accessibility performance using Lighthouse & PageSpeed Insights for diagnosis & feedback throughout the development cycle.
- Reduced ‘time to interactive’ by 177%  by designing an asynchronous image component that dynamically requests appropriately sized images from a CDN without blocking rendering or interactivity.
- Produced high quality, extendable & robust code with the team using a continuous integration (CI) workflow with CircleCI & SonarCloud while testing over 70% branch coverage with Jest & Enzyme.
- Worked on multiple Git branches with a team of 6 other developers.
- Conducted code reviews associated with Git pull requests.

positions.title: Project - Streamfinder, Product Manager | React, MongoDB, Mongoose, Express, Node
positions.description:
A movie streaming selection service that allows for finding & rating movies, as well as linking to streaming services.

- Conducted group standups, coordinated Trello ticketing, and implemented  SCRUM Agile methodology for a team of 6.
- Held client meetings & wrote the project proposal.
- Conducted code reviews associated with Git pull requests.
- Designed server architecture that is modular & easy for the team to add API routes to. 
- Inherited another team member’s search component & completed the react component, refactored server code to help other teammates better interface with it.
- Developed & unit tested a fuzzy search component for more useful & robust search results.

positions.title: Project - Ratings & Reviews Microservice, Back End | PostgreSQL, Sequelize, Redis, AWS (EC2)
positions.description:
- Built a scalable microservice architecture back end, accessible by API endpoints for full CRUD functionality & initially populated with 5GB of data using an ETL process to load CSV data into Postgres.
- Achieved fast & iterative testing without affecting the production environment DB by utilizing migration & seeding of a test environment DB using Sequelize with Postgres, while testing over 80% of code with Jest.
- Improved DB read speed by 83% with selective indexing & a further 65% with strategic joins using insights from K6 on a development database containing 9 million entries & 22 million relations.
- Stress tested a deployed microservice on AWS EC2 instances using Loader.io to track improvements & validate metrics while adding Redis & NGINX across multiple EC2 instances in order to reach over 1000 rps sustained over 1 min.

positions.title: Software - API Testing | C#, NUnit, Visual Studio, DLL, API
positions.description:
- Created automated testing suites in C# to test the APIs of multiple company products, including dynamically generating test models, reading program state, and exporting results, reducing testing time by more than half.
- Crafted code base and Visual Studio settings carefully to re-use over 80% of shared code for testing across multiple platforms and versions of API.
- Used interfaces and generics to extend code flexibility of testing and reduce redundant code.

positions.title: Software - GUI Testing Tool | VB.Net, C#, WPF, XML, UX
positions.description:
Created a VB.net & WPF -based GUI program on top of the CLI project to allow dynamic and interactive use of the database and testing, as well as automated and assisted creation of new examples, including the generation and editing of necessary XML storage files and directory structures.  The program makes use of many elements including file I/O, multithreaded behavior, C# dll project references, coordination with a command line program in concurrent development, and CSi product APIs.

- Decreased time in creating examples by over 90%, running/reviewing tests results by over 50% & creating new regression & verification tests by over 90% by creating an intuitive UI program with WPF/WCF/XAML.
- Allows developers to asynchronously run tests, view results & create/modify/record new examples/benchmarks. 
- Improved viewing of results by displaying test run status and results in real time through an intuitive interface.
- Provides efficient, dynamic & interactive use of examples database in order to integrate testing into daily workflows of developers, testers & tech support to record & fix bugs.
- Made testing more accessible to other company employees as it brought the required knowledge down from knowledge of editing XML files and understanding the full testing system for proper usage to using a basic GUI with intuitive defaults that anyone could easily engage with.

positions.title: Software - CLI Testing Tool | VB.Net, XML, MDB, DLL, PHP, CSS, VBA
positions.description:
Collaborating with a coworker, architected & created an aggregate-oriented database based on XML file storage to be used for automated end-to-end testing of CSi products. Occasionally 3rd party libraries or Excel calcs w/ VBA were used to augment behavior. 

- Increased speed of running end-to-end (e2e) tests by over 500% by automating processes.
- Used C#, VB.Net & Excel VBA coding to interface with the APIs, Excel & storage in XML & MDB distributed database formats.
- Grew total testing suite by over 400% & consolidated/normalized suites across multiple apps.
- Ran tests locally and on remote virtual machine clusters.
- Results displayed as HTML files locally and hosted online.
- Assisted developers in assessing performance tuning features by including test time history metrics.
- Made testing more accessible to other company employees as it brought the required knowledge down from knowledge of VBA to editing XML files.
- Created online company wiki documentation of testing system and test examples.

positions.title: Software Verification & Development - Manual Testing | VBA
positions.description:
- Automated processes within Excel using VBA coding to interface with the software API, Microsoft Access databases, and Microsoft Excel.
- Verified & documented design codes of worldwide origin; expanded the published & internal testing examples by over 200%.
- Prepared & fixed documentation of existing & new example problems shipped with the software.
- Developed new software features, validated software calculations & tested resolution of bugs. 
       * Example: Optimization of the nonlinear effects of cable-stayed bridge cable tensioning during construction to achieve desired bridge deck shape post-construction.
       * Example: Implementation of the U.S. aluminum design code, including solving of cubic formulas & interpretation of design code documents considering mechanics of solids concepts.
- Verified the accuracy of SAP2000, CSiBridge, SAFE & ETABS software analysis & design with manual calculations & automated testing suites using multivariable calculus, matrix algebra & linear algebra with differential equations for topics such as nonlinear geometry, nonlinear material, statics & structural dynamics.
       * Example: At the request of a client, Bechtel, validated various ways SAP2000 handled material damping & created a documented example model, paired Excel calculations & report. Derived formula for the case of a ramp-step dynamic loading with damping on a cantilever & confirmed precise dynamic responses over a range of time by comparing step output.

positions.title: Independent Contractor - Design Structural Engineer
positions.description:
- Performed analysis through ETABS of a seismic retrofit using BRBs (Buckling-Restrained Braces) for a school. 
- Wrote customized VBA in Excel for automating some custom displays of program results, including modifying data from BRB developers in light of what CSi software developers told me about their implementations. 
- Developed a method of accounting for gamma & omega overstrength design of beams and columns adjacent to the BRBs using staged construction, with plans to automate the procedure in a future ETABS/SAP2000 plugin with C#.
positions.insights: Skills: Structural Engineering · Seismic Design · Structural Dynamics · Steel Structures · Software Development · Application Programming Interfaces · VBA · Structural Analysis

- Extended the curriculum to begin introducing students to programming through Excel and interfacing with the SAP2000 API. Students later told me these off-road explorations led to new career opportunities for them.

positions.description:
Worked abroad in Doha, Qatar, on the design of various steel and composite structures on a $1.5 billion project to be constructed in Doha, Qatar. The project included high rise structures, long spans, & complex building systems such as a suspended floor system. 

- Made hand drawings to work out steel construction details. 
- Created SAP2000 models to verify design engineer work and to conduct non-linear time history analysis to consider the effects of long-period seismic vibrations on the tall buildings in the project. 
- Advised other employees in proper use of SAP2000 and ETABS software in the analysis and design process.

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.description:
Went above & beyond the award by earning more than double the merit badges required. I earned 83 merit badges, many of which were earned by my checking out books from the library, finding counselors in my area, self-teaching from the books & getting tested/certified by the counselors.

I also went on to be a camp counselor at Camp New Fork in Wyoming for a summer, specializing on working at the water front as a lifeguard & teaching canoeing, the wood shop, and on the rifle range teaching Scouts how to safely use & maintain rifles & shotguns.
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Volunteered my time to design & teach a winter mountaineering clinic to the UC Berkeley outdoor group from Jan-May each Spring.
- Prepared an organized set of notes, photos & diagrams that over the years became a +100 page book covering snow camping, avalanche safety & rescue, winter weather, glacier travel & rescue, as well as various aspects of climbing on snow, ice & mixed terrain.
- Taught weekly 1 hr lectures, based loosely on the notes but focusing on topics better presented in person.
- Led two capstone field climbs for the course for students who attended enough of the lectures. A beginner outing could progress less experienced students to attend the advanced outing. Both outings were overnights where a high camp was established where we practiced skills & concepts covered in class. Students who showed themselves to be safe enough participated in a summit ascent the 2nd day.
    - Beginner: Lassen Peak via S Slopes.
    - Advanced: Mt Shasta via Casaval Ridge, West Face, Shastina.
- Although this was a volunteer course that I proposed to teach to the outdoor club, each year students told me that my course surpassed many paid programs in terms of breadth, depth & quality of instruction.

Coming soon: Trip planning features

- Allows developers to asynchronously run tests, view results & create/modify/record new examples/benchmarks. 
- Improved viewing of results by displaying test run status and results in real time through an intuitive interface.
- Provides efficient, dynamic & interactive use of examples database in order to integrate testing into daily workflows of developers, testers & tech support to record & fix bugs.

volunteerExperience.description:
- Volunteered my time to design & teach a winter mountaineering clinic to the UC Berkeley outdoor group from Jan-May each Spring.
- Prepared an organized set of notes, photos & diagrams that over the years became a +100 page book covering snow camping, avalanche safety & rescue, winter weather, glacier travel & rescue, as well as various aspects of climbing on snow, ice & mixed terrain.
- Taught weekly 1 hr lectures, based loosely on the notes but focusing on topics better presented in person.
- Led two capstone field climbs for the course for students who attended enough of the lectures. A beginner outing could progress less experienced students to attend the advanced outing. Both outings were overnights where a high camp was established where we practiced skills & concepts covered in class. Students who showed themselves to be safe enough participated in a summit ascent the 2nd day.
    - Beginner: Lassen Peak via S Slopes.
    - Advanced: Mt Shasta via Casaval Ridge, West Face, Shastina.
- Although this was a volunteer course that I proposed to teach to the outdoor club, each year students told me that my course surpassed many paid programs in terms of breadth, depth & quality of instruction.
